title: Thornwold's central hold-grief (The Gallows Glade) offers only two resolution actions and both are WILL-gated ('speak the rest-oath from memory' DC12, 'swear the Company's oath' DC11) — no wits/lore option, unlike almost every other read-aloud/verse resolution in the game, which favored a Scholar. With will+2 at the time I failed 4 rolls in a row (7,1,2,6 vs needed 10/9+) before succeeding, losing Barrow-Keepers and Free Companies standing along the way.
